name: Spanish Common Words Set 27
description: This set is part of a larger collection focusing on common Spanish words, building vocabulary with frequently used nouns, verbs, and adjectives not covered in previous sets.

cards.sentence: Pasamos la tarde en el salón, leyendo un buen libro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We spent the afternoon in the living room, reading a good book.

cards.sentence: Tomamos un taxi para ir al aeropuerto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We took a taxi to go to the airport.

cards.sentence: Llevaba unas botas de cuero marrones para el frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He wore brown leather boots for the cold.

cards.sentence: Me regaló una pulsera de plata en mi cumpleaños.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He gave me a silver bracelet for my birthday.

cards.sentence: Perdió su collar de perlas favorito en la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She lost her favorite pearl necklace at the party.

cards.sentence: Sus pendientes brillaban bajo la luz del sol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Her earrings shone under the sunlight.

cards.sentence: Guarda la leche fresca en el refrigerador para que no se eche a perder.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Keep the fresh milk in the refrigerator so it doesn't spoil.

cards.sentence: Por favor, saca la basura antes de que huela mal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Please, take out the trash before it smells bad.

cards.sentence: Compró un saco de patatas en el mercado local.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He bought a sack of potatoes at the local market.

cards.sentence: El agua sale por el tubo roto de la tubería principal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The water comes out through the broken pipe of the main pipeline.

cards.sentence: Se sentó cómodamente en el sillón a leer el periódico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He sat comfortably in the armchair to read the newspaper.

cards.sentence: Enciende el ventilador, hace mucho calor en esta habitación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Turn on the fan, it's very hot in this room.

cards.sentence: La calefacción funciona muy bien y mantiene la casa caliente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The heating works very well and keeps the house warm.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos aire acondicionado en verano para soportar el calor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need air conditioning in summer to endure the heat.

cards.sentence: El despertador sonó a las seis de la mañana en punto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The alarm clock rang at six in the morning sharp.

cards.sentence: Pon los platos sucios en el lavavajillas después de cenar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Put the dirty dishes in the dishwasher after dinner.

cards.sentence: Observaron células con el microscopio en la clase de biología.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They observed cells with the microscope in biology class.

cards.sentence: Usaron un telescopio para ver las estrellas y planetas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They used a telescope to see the stars and planets.

cards.sentence: La linterna no tiene pilas, así que no funciona.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flashlight has no batteries, so it doesn't work.

cards.sentence: Un caracol se movía lentamente por la hoja de la planta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A snail was moving slowly on the plant leaf.

cards.sentence: Una mariposa de colores se posó en la flor del jardín.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A colorful butterfly landed on the garden flower.

cards.sentence: Una abeja recogía néctar de las flores para hacer miel.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A bee was collecting nectar from the flowers to make honey.

cards.sentence: Una fila de hormigas caminaba por el suelo buscando comida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A line of ants was walking on the ground looking for food.

cards.sentence: Una araña tejió su tela en la esquina de la ventana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A spider wove its web in the corner of the window.

cards.sentence: Vimos un cocodrilo en el río durante el safari.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We saw a crocodile in the river during the safari.

cards.sentence: El elefante es el animal terrestre más grande del mundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The elephant is the largest land animal in the world.

cards.sentence: La jirafa tiene un cuello muy largo para alcanzar las hojas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The giraffe has a very long neck to reach the leaves.

cards.sentence: El mono comía un plátano con sus manos en el árbol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The monkey was eating a banana with its hands in the tree.

cards.sentence: El tigre ruge fuerte en la jungla al anochecer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The tiger roars loudly in the jungle at dusk.

cards.sentence: El zorro es un animal astuto y difícil de atrapar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The fox is a cunning animal and difficult to catch.

cards.sentence: El lobo aulló a la luna llena en la noche fría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The wolf howled at the full moon on the cold night.

cards.sentence: El oso hiberna durante el invierno para ahorrar energía.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bear hibernates during winter to save energy.

cards.sentence: La rana saltó al estanque cuando nos acercamos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The frog jumped into the pond when we approached.

cards.sentence: Ten cuidado con esa serpiente venenosa en el camino.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Be careful with that venomous snake on the path.

cards.sentence: La tortuga camina muy despacio, pero llega lejos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The turtle walks very slowly, but it goes far.

cards.sentence: Los patos nadan en el lago y buscan comida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The ducks swim in the lake and look for food.

cards.sentence: La gallina puso un huevo esta mañana en el gallinero.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The hen laid an egg this morning in the hen house.

cards.sentence: El gallo canta al amanecer para despertar a todos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The rooster crows at dawn to wake everyone up.

cards.sentence: Las ovejas pastan tranquilamente en el campo verde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sheep graze peacefully in the green field.

cards.sentence: El conejo saltó entre los arbustos rápidamente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The rabbit hopped quickly among the bushes.

cards.sentence: La ardilla escondió sus nueces en el hueco del árbol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The squirrel hid its nuts in the tree hollow.

cards.sentence: El búho es un ave nocturna que caza de noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The owl is a nocturnal bird that hunts at night.

cards.sentence: El águila volaba alto en el cielo, buscando su presa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The eagle flew high in the sky, looking for its prey.

cards.sentence: Los delfines son muy inteligentes y juegan en el mar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Dolphins are very intelligent and play in the sea.

cards.sentence: La ballena es el mamífero más grande del océano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The whale is the largest mammal in the ocean.

cards.sentence: Un tiburón nadaba cerca de la costa, asustando a la gente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A shark swam near the coast, scaring people.

cards.sentence: El pulpo tiene ocho brazos largos para moverse y cazar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The octopus has eight long arms to move and hunt.

cards.sentence: Comimos calamares fritos en un restaurante de mariscos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We ate fried squid at a seafood restaurant.

cards.sentence: El cangrejo se escondió bajo la roca cuando me acerqué.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The crab hid under the rock when I approached.

cards.sentence: La langosta es un marisco delicioso, pero muy caro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Lobster is a delicious, but very expensive, seafood.

cards.sentence: Pedimos un plato de camarones a la plancha para compartir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We ordered a plate of grilled shrimp to share.

cards.sentence: Me gusta la ensalada fresca con tomate y lechuga.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like fresh salad with tomato and lettuce.

cards.sentence: De postre, tomamos fruta fresca y un poco de helado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: For dessert, we had fresh fruit and some ice cream.

cards.sentence: La ternera a la brasa es mi favorita en este restaurante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Grilled beef is my favorite at this restaurant.

cards.sentence: El cordero asado es un plato tradicional de la región.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Roast lamb is a traditional dish of the region.

cards.sentence: Comimos pavo en Acción de Gracias con toda la familia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We ate turkey on Thanksgiving with the whole family.

cards.sentence: El jamón serrano es una delicia española muy apreciada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Serrano ham is a highly prized Spanish delicacy.

cards.sentence: Desayunó huevos revueltos y salchichas en la cama.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He had scrambled eggs and sausages for breakfast in bed.

cards.sentence: Pidió una hamburguesa con queso y patatas fritas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He ordered a cheeseburger with French fries.

cards.sentence: Cenamos una pizza grande con pepperoni y champiñones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We had a large pizza with pepperoni and mushrooms for dinner.

cards.sentence: Preparé un sándwich de jamón y queso para el almuerzo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I made a ham and cheese sandwich for lunch.

cards.sentence: No encuentro un fósforo para encender la vela en la oscuridad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I can't find a match to light the candle in the dark.

cards.sentence: La cuchilla de afeitar está muy afilada, ten cuidado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The razor blade is very sharp, be careful.

cards.sentence: Cortó la leña con un hacha vieja en el bosque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He cut the firewood with an old axe in the forest.

cards.sentence: El carrete de pescar se atascó durante la pesca.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The fishing reel got stuck during fishing.

cards.sentence: Puso cebo fresco en el anzuelo para atrapar peces.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He put fresh bait on the fishhook to catch fish.

cards.sentence: Llevaba su caña de pescar al río cada domingo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He took his fishing rod to the river every Sunday.

cards.sentence: Remamos con los remos hasta la orilla del lago.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We rowed with the oars to the lake shore.

cards.sentence: Encendí una vela para crear un ambiente más acogedor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I lit a candle to create a cozier atmosphere.

cards.sentence: El remo se rompió por la mitad durante la tormenta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The oar broke in half during the storm.

cards.sentence: La bomba de agua no funciona, necesitamos repararla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The water pump is not working, we need to repair it.

cards.sentence: La grúa levantó el coche averiado de la carretera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The crane lifted the broken-down car from the road.

cards.sentence: La tuerca estaba muy apretada y no podía girarla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The nut was very tight and he couldn't turn it.

cards.sentence: Aseguró la estructura con un perno grande y resistente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He secured the structure with a large, sturdy bolt.

cards.sentence: Pegó el cartel con cinta adhesiva en la pared.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He taped the poster to the wall with adhesive tape.

cards.sentence: Modeló una figura de arcilla para su proyecto de arte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She molded a figure from clay for her art project.

cards.sentence: La estatua era de mármol blanco y brillante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The statue was made of shiny white marble.

cards.sentence: El edificio está hecho de hormigón reforzado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The building is made of reinforced concrete.

cards.sentence: La casa está construida con ladrillos rojos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The house is built with red bricks.

cards.sentence: Las gotas de lluvia caían en la ventana sin parar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The raindrops fell on the window non-stop.

cards.sentence: Había un charco grande en la calle después de la tormenta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There was a large puddle in the street after the storm.

cards.sentence: La ola era enorme y rompió con fuerza en la playa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The wave was huge and broke strongly on the beach.

cards.sentence: Caminamos junto a un pequeño arroyo en el bosque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We walked next to a small stream in the forest.

cards.sentence: Navegaron por el Golfo de México durante su viaje.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They sailed through the Gulf of Mexico during their trip.

cards.sentence: La laguna es poco profunda y está llena de aves acuáticas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The lagoon is shallow and full of waterfowl.

cards.sentence: Se perdieron en el pantano denso y oscuro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They got lost in the dense, dark swamp.

cards.sentence: El Gran Cañón es una maravilla natural impresionante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The Grand Canyon is an impressive natural wonder.

cards.sentence: Las dunas de arena del desierto son hermosas al amanecer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The desert sand dunes are beautiful at sunrise.

cards.sentence: El cráter del volcán emite vapor constantemente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The volcano's crater constantly emits steam.

cards.sentence: Las flores silvestres cubrían la pradera en primavera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Wildflowers covered the meadow in spring.

cards.sentence: Vive en el distrito financiero de la ciudad, cerca de su trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He lives in the city's financial district, close to his job.

cards.sentence: Pasaron las vacaciones en una villa de lujo en la costa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They spent their vacation in a luxury villa on the coast.

cards.sentence: Cruzaron la frontera de noche para evitar problemas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They crossed the border at night to avoid problems.

cards.sentence: El litoral español es extenso y tiene muchas playas hermosas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The Spanish coastline is extensive and has many beautiful beaches.

cards.sentence: La Osa Mayor es una constelación conocida en el hemisferio norte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Ursa Major is a well-known constellation in the northern hemisphere.

cards.sentence: Hubo un eclipse de sol el mes pasado que se pudo ver en la ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There was a solar eclipse last month that could be seen in the city.

cards.sentence: La atmósfera de la Tierra nos protege de la radiación solar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The Earth's atmosphere protects us from solar radiation.

cards.sentence: Un tornado devastó la zona rural, dejando muchos daños.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A tornado devastated the rural area, causing much damage.

cards.sentence: La erupción del volcán fue espectacular, con mucha lava.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The volcano's eruption was spectacular, with a lot of lava.

cards.sentence: Un deslizamiento de tierra bloqueó la carretera de la montaña.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A landslide blocked the mountain road.
